description:
What is this Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Pin & Clip that attaches the Emergency Brake Cable to the Drum Brake Lever.
It fits the #1 Emergency Brake Cable & #2 Emergency Brake Cable
Suzuki OEM Parts
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Pin & Cotter
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
